---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or new check for officelens
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Problem**

What accessibility gap or workflow pain are you hitting? Describe the DOCX or
PPTX content that officelens does not currently handle. Note the relevant WCAG
requirement where you can.

**Proposed solution**

What you would like officelens to do. If you are proposing a new rule, sketch
the check and the failure it should report, and say whether it applies to DOCX,
PPTX, or both.

**Alternatives**

Any workarounds you use today, and why they are not good enough.
